author: lukehan2001
body:
I'd appreciate it if someone could provide a team for me. It's fine if it's a new team.

I normally play as an engineer on most maps, such as Senex and Rendevouz. I build walls, defensive structures and set traps, such as pitfalls and other things like that. If water and iron is available, I combine water and my wall to create this nearly unpassable wall. It worked once on Rendevous 3 for the whole round. I play mainly as defense and build structures to stop the enemy players.
